continuity.method: mean absolute difference of consecutive raw frames at 24 evenly spaced windows; large stable jumps would indicate timelapse or cuts

0TY6LVvMpUo.interpretation: continuous (review could still cut between windows)

findings: The frozen pipeline emits failing_event within its first 8-11 sampled seconds and holds FAILING for 96-99% of every one of the seven videos, including two independently confirmed continuous real-time normal prints: it does not behave plausibly on independent footage.

Normal-print false alarming is confirmed as the dominant failure mode on independent footage: the two clean real-time normal prints scored raw P(failing) ~0.92 and ~0.75 on average and were classified failing essentially always. Extends the internal UE003 weakness to a systematic external finding. Most urgent data gap: diverse normal printing footage.

No software problem found: Python and C++ produce identical state/event sequences (0 state diffs, identical events) with raw P within 0.073 max absolute deviation, inside the 0.15 decoder-build floor. The fault is in the frozen model's outputs, not the runtime.

Gross failure detection is qualitatively real when the failure is obvious: both spaghetti clips received raw P >= 0.6 for all samples, post-warmup FAILING 100% and 25-of-26, and the VLM described the same gross failure. The blob/ESteps clips were also alarmed from second ~9 and therefore provide no positive evidence for detection.

Next step: do not tune thresholds against this unseen set (would be leakage). The path is a model/dataset change - acquire diverse licensed normal-printing footage in fixed-camera real-time capture, expand the training distribution, then re-validate against this same frozen evaluation set. Standardize future evaluation capture standards (fixed camera, real-time, printer-mounted).
limitations: Small set (7 videos); 2 clips (0TY6LVvMpUo, 38gnsbGqcx4) are produced/edited review content.

Fine-grained or transient conditions in G56LQfQCUnA and 38gnsbGqcx4 are below both the 384px-grid VLM and 224px model resolution; 'false alarm' there means no visible basis, not proven absence of failure.
VLM proposals are a non-authoritative second observer; kept separate, never ground truth.
No quantitative accuracy claims are made.
YouTube footage is not redistributable; evaluation-only use.
